description: Links the signed-in client owner to their enrollment link using its token. The user's verified email must match the owner email on the link. It approves nothing.

idempotencyKey.description: Stable key for this request; reuse it when retrying the same request.

sessionId.description: The owner's enrollment session from the link.

token.description: The token from the owner link.
